narrative.overview:
A personal journal set over a night photograph that is painted live in code. Deep navy is the negative space; the photograph supplies every colour, and the type is warm ivory, crisp and quiet. The site refuses the white-paper blog and the photo-hero-plus-cards template: there are no cards, borders, fills, or ornaments, so the only things on the page are text and the exposure behind it.

The photograph is a fragment shader (`public/night.js`) drawing a defocused, grain-heavy exposure with broad halation, one subject at a time, dissolving between three scenes. The home scene is lit and sits in the right half of the desktop viewport (lower right on phones, under-exposed, developing as the reader nears the end of the page). Article pages hold one dimmed still frame so nothing animates while someone reads. The shared confirmed identity is the author mark `李至青`; the page composition itself belongs to `.impeccable/surfaces/route-zh-tw.md`, not to this system.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, warm ivory text in three tones, and nothing else on the page but the live scene.
Serif for voice (greeting, titles, reading), system sans for quiet controls and dates.
Flat and frameless: spacing and tone carry all hierarchy; text-shadow keeps ivory crisp where the exposure blooms.
The scene is sparing with motion: 24fps, still under reduced motion, still on articles, pausable by the reader.

rules.name: The Photograph Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: The interface has no accent colour. Hue comes from the scene; the interface answers with ivory in three tones.

rules.name: The Three Ivories Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy in tone is one of three: ivory (active), soft (reading and rest), muted (metadata). Hover moves a link one step up, never sideways to another hue.

rules.name: The System Voice Rule
rules.body: System font stacks only; no webfonts.

rules.name: The Regular Chrome Rule
rules.body: Every role outside authored article content (article title, subheadings, `strong`) is weight 400.

rules.name: The Unadorned Link Rule
rules.body: Links never use underlines in any state. Interactivity is a one-step tone shift toward ivory, and keyboard focus is the global 3px ivory outline with a 4px offset.

rules.name: The Chinese Reading Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Sustained zh-TW text keeps 1.5 to 1.9 line-height, normal tracking, and strict line breaking; positive tracking is only for the signature and section labels.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Article prose stays at or below 68ch at 1.9 line-height.

rules.name: The Scene Sits Behind Rule
rules.body: The canvas is fixed at `100lvh`, `z-index: -1`, aria-hidden, and non-interactive. It fades in over 2800ms once its first frame is drawn; text never moves to make room for it.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Depth belongs to the scene, never to containers or controls.

rules.name: The No Border Rule
rules.body: Borders and fills never separate sections, rows, or endings.

rules.name: The External Arrow Rule
rules.body: Every link that leaves the site ends with the same top-right arrow icon (`M4.5 11.5 11.5 4.5M5.5 4.5h6v6`, 16-unit grid, 1.4 stroke), opens in a new tab, and carries a visually hidden new-tab note. Internal and mail links never use it.

dos: **Do** set text in the three ivories on the navy ground and let the photograph supply all colour.
**Do** use system font stacks only: the serif for voice and reading, the sans for quiet controls.
**Do** keep every type role at or below `1.5rem`, and every role at weight 400 except authored article title, subheadings, and `strong`.
**Do** keep links underline-free with a visible 3px ivory focus outline.
**Do** keep sections frameless and separate them with space.
**Do** keep the scene still on articles, under reduced motion, and when the reader has paused it.
**Do** end the bio and every article with the prompt-free Response Ending.
donts: **Don't** use shader hues as interface colour (links, fills, borders, text).
**Don't** add cards, borders, fills, rounded containers, or ornaments.
**Don't** introduce webfonts or oversized display type.
**Don't** add bold to interface, metadata, list, or CTA text.
**Don't** place a prompt above the Response Ending.
**Don't** let the scene carry text, controls, or meaning; it is aria-hidden atmosphere.
